description: Rokid Glasses AIUI Agent - outfit check: buying clothes and not sure if a piece matches or suits the occasion - describe the garment with selectors (type, colour, pattern, fit), what you will pair it with, and the occasion; a built-in rule table (colour pairing, pattern clash, occasion fit) gives a verdict - matches / so-so / does not match - plus two concrete fix suggestions, an optional LanguageModel pass over the TEXT description only adds two styling tips, and a mirror re-check closes the loop; the record photo is never judged - the agent cannot see the clothes, every judgement comes from your description and the rules
name: outfit-check
